paragraphs: STChealth sells vaccine intelligence for monitoring, managing, and mobilizing immunization data. The platform connects consumers, providers, and public health, which the homepage frames as a comprehensive view of the vaccination record. Reports and dashboards carry that data, described as easy to understand and aimed at clear and quick answers.

The homepage names the company as an Immunization Information Systems vendor able to respond to changing needs. Earlier work listed on the about page includes an immunization registry solution, IWeb, taken to market. A national immunization data exchange network is described as linking pharmacies to state IIS.

The homepage runs testimonials, one from the chief pharmacy officer at Tarrytown Pharmacy. The second is from a program manager at the Louisiana Department of Health, about vaccine management through the COVID-19 response.

quote.text: STChealth connects public and private health care data
